tools.name: search_files
tools.description: Search repository text files for a literal query.

tools.name: read_file
tools.description: Read a bounded range from a repository file.

tools.name: apply_patch
tools.description: Apply a raw Git unified diff to existing tracked text files within the task's allowed paths. New files, renames, copies, and binary patches are not supported. The patch must begin with 'diff --git' and contain ---/+++/@@ lines. Do not use '*** Begin Patch' or '*** End Patch' markers.

tools.name: run_check
tools.description: Run one task-registered public check by ID. A passing result is valid only for the exact current worktree diff; any later patch requires another check.

tools.name: get_diff
tools.description: Return the current Git diff and size summary. Call this after all registered checks pass for the current diff so the next turn can perform final review.

tools.name: finish_task
tools.description: Submit the current patch for deterministic evaluation. Call only after every registered check passes for the current diff and the complete final get_diff result has been reviewed in this turn.
